description: Java servlet class 'ImageUrlServlet' handling image URL requests by retrieving content and data resource from the database and forwarding to an image view or returning a 404 error.

classes.name: ImageUrlServlet
classes.description: Servlet class for handling image URL requests, retrieving content and data resource, and forwarding to image view or error response.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests by delegating to doGet method.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Processes GET requests to retrieve image content based on URL path, fetches content and data resource from database, and forwards to image view or returns 404 if not found.
